subject: Hospitality
title: Space Hotels: The Final Frontier
description: One-minute skill: Space Hotels: The Final Frontier.

hook.text: Orbital Reef and Voyager Station plan to host tourists in low Earth orbit by the 2030s. Hotel design meets zero gravity.

buildup.text: Space hotel challenges include micro-gravity sleeping, radiation shielding, waste recycling.

discovery.text: Voyager Station uses rotation for artificial gravity—a spinning wheel in space where guests can walk normally in their rooms.

twist.text: Early tickets are expected to cost $5 million+. Space tourism will start as ultra-luxury and slowly trickle down.

climax.text: The Earth view—the 'overview effect'—may be the most powerful amenity possible.

punchline.text: $5 million a night, Earth from your window. The ultimate hotel room has no ground.

quiz.question: How does Voyager Station plan to solve the gravity problem?
options: A spinning ring structure that creates artificial gravity through rotation
